Definition: to tread down, i.e. subjugate; specifically, to crumble off
BiblicalUsage: 1) to rule, have dominion, dominate, tread down; 1a) (Qal) to have dominion, rule, subjugate; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to dominate; 2) to scrape out; 2a) (Qal) to scrape, scrape out
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
